_comment: Project-scope MCP config for the elicitation probe. Run Claude Code from
THIS directory so it is auto-discovered and `uv run` resolves against this
folder -- no absolute path here, because one rots the moment the repo is
cloned elsewhere or checked out as a worktree.
`test-elicit` is plain Flow A (form mode, capability-gated): the default
worth measuring, since URL mode and tasks are both still unreachable.
To probe those, point Claude Code at a throwaway --mcp-config instead;
the README has the exact invocation.
